selectionPolicy.goal: Best-selling worldwide models where comparable sales evidence exists
selectionPolicy.fallback: Qualitative field-service priority, explicitly inferred; not a sales ranking
selectionPolicy.rankingUnit: Exact orderable model; transmitter/receiver pair counts once
selectionPolicy.deduplication: One canonical pack per exact model/compatible pair; multiple type listings may reference it
selectionPolicy.publicationGate: Exact model and regional variant, official manual, per-fact evidence and validated downloadable pack
selectionPolicy.note: Target 20 per type remains open. First release is documentation-led, not a model-level worldwide sales ranking. Multiple electrical/connector variants do not establish independent popularity.

manufacturerPoolStatus: Research leads; not a sales ranking or verified model list

taxonomySources.scope: Example of official SOPAS parameter documentation; not confirmation of model rankings or all-model software compatibility

configurationResearchContract.appliesTo: Every exact model, including software-parameterized sensors and industrial code readers
configurationResearchContract.evidenceRule: Each populated fact requires exact model applicability and official document URL, revision, page or section. Unknown remains unknown; do not infer family-wide compatibility.
